# Get Parent Directory

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Get's the parent directory of a file

## Syntax

~~~~text
getParentDirectory(file: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getParentDirectory(file: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
